notes: Lane Z (merge/contract) owns no items. It carries cross-lane questions raised while merging lanes A-E; per-lane questions stay in each lane's file.

Lane Z fix: removed schema=compose-go-embedded from the 7 build.shm_size fields in C.json (Lane C reported it as a generator mistake). build.shm_size is integer|string in both compose-spec.json and compose-go-embedded.json (#/$defs/workload_spec/properties/build/oneOf/1/properties/shm_size); only container_spec.shm_size differs.

Decided by the user 2026-11-08 (Pass 4.5 Lane Z), applied to A-E by Lane Z; the four cross-lane questions and the lane questions they answer (B: logs name, service/task inspect sensitivity; C: compose logs output; D: whole-Dockerfile sensitivity; E: buildkit_version, docker_cli_version) are closed.

Logs (Pass 4.5 Lane Z corrections): every logs item (engine:container-logs, swarm:service-logs, swarm:task-logs, compose:cli-logs) has raw `logs` (text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>") hashed as `content_sha256`, and structured `log_entries` list(object({timestamp, stream, source, message})); stream is stdout|stderr, or combined for a TTY; only message is sensitive. logs_json is gone. Each records `inputs` tail (default 1000) and since; rule L1.

Sixth category `result`: the outcome of running an action or a descriptive value about how data was produced, not the identity or state of a lasting object. Every structured output of an action is now `result` (prune results, container state after start/stop/..., exec/wait/run results, service update_status/update_response/mode/service_status, node spec, swarm tls_info/swarm_info/join_tokens, buildx bake/metadata/status/result); plus root_rotation_in_progress, force_update, image created, dockerfile reconstructed/fidelity, stack service_status. Identity handoff values (deleted IDs, tokens, digests) stay identity. V2 still asks resources and data sources for a structured output; V4 also applies to object-typed result outputs.

Sensitivity is per field (new rule V5): a structured or result output is sensitive as a whole only with a `sensitive_reason` (only the three join_tokens outputs, where every field is a secret). Otherwise the output is not sensitive and the secret-carrying FIELDs carry `sensitive: true`. Raw outputs (JSON/text strings) stay sensitive as before; hashes never are. Secret channels marked: container/service/task env, plugin settings/config env, image config env, volume driver options (CIFS/NFS passwords), compose environment/env_file/secrets/build args/ssh/secrets/dockerfile_inline/configs content/environment-sourced values, Dockerfile ENV values/ARG defaults/history created_by, build provenance, attestation statements, buildx driver_opts, bake args/secret/ssh/dockerfile_inline, log lines, exec/run stdout/stderr, registry identity_token. A `dynamic` field cannot hide nested values, so the whole field is marked (stack service spec, image config blobs, provenance).

Sensitivity judgment calls by Lane Z, reversible: (1) command lines (container args/cmd/entrypoint, service Args/Command, compose ps Command, compose top processes) are NOT a secret channel, following Lane A and CONTRACT.md's list; B and C had treated them as sensitive, so compose:cli-ps containers and compose:cli-top processes are now plain. (2) Lane C's parent-level marks on the whole `secrets` and `configs` maps were dropped (they hid every field); their environment/content children stay marked. (3) compose networks/models slices carry no secret channel and are now plain. Accepted risk: a secret interpolated (${VAR}) into a field that is not a secret channel is no longer hidden in plans; secrets belong in environment/secrets.

Version names (Pass 4.5 Lane Z corrections): V3 reads the registry in SCHEMA.md. docker_cli_version is registered but only allowed on items with uses_cli true; every item now carries uses_cli, and all are false (the provider never runs the docker CLI), so docker_cli_version was removed from stack, stacks, stack-services, manifest-list and manifest-inspect.

Result (Pass 4.5 Lane Z corrections): rule V6, every action has a result output. 26 actions had none and got one: archive_size (exports, image save/load), path_stat (upload, cp), changes (commits), image / built_images (build, import), enabled (plugin create), push_status / pull_status (plugin push, compose push/pull), autolock_managers (rotate unlock key), removed_counts (compose down), layers (compose publish), container_states (compose kill/pause/restart/scale/start/stop/unpause/up).
